'''Mike Kessling Hidden Base with ground pound 2 0''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Mike Kessling]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-395">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/395 Hidden Base with ground pound 2 0], DeckTech (Michael "Troop1023" Kessling, 5 September 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/395/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/395/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018231628/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/395/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Published:''' 5 September 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Hidden Base with ground pound 2 0''

* '''Strategy:''' This is a new version of my old favorite, Hidden Base w/ Gwound Pound. It has more anti HDADTJ cards. The focus is still to hold the sky and the ground with battle order.

== Original post ==

'''Hidden Base with ground pound 2 0'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "Troop1023" Kessling
* '''Published:''' September 5, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is a new version of my old favorite, Hidden Base w/ Gwound Pound. It has more anti HDADTJ cards. The focus is still to hold the sky and the ground with battle order.

=== Strategy ===

This deck uses HB to get a good amount of force going. It then will set up in space, and use EPP hit squads to kill oponnents guys. Once you know where high destinies are, feel free to put out Obi/Luke against Epic Duel. Cancel Visage with a bothan, and give him some back up. Fights well in space and ground. beats ops, ISB, black and blue, and more. Requires high playskill to use effectively.
